summary: Verified this session's TipJar feature batch. Backend: mandatory self star-rating (3/3 tests), AI feed ordered ascending by kickoff, share-image for member tip (pending) + rejection of hq-auto, and text-only analyze all PASS. Combo AI parlays soft-SKIPPED (none in DB right now). One CRITICAL backend bug found: POST /api/tips/analyze with the `files` field returns 422 for ANY upload (single or multi) — the multi-image feature is broken end-to-end at the API layer. Frontend: 'Community Picks' rename verified, Submit modal shows 'Up to 4 images' hint, upload-input has `multiple` attr, self-rating-block appears after AI scan, publish-button correctly disabled until stars are chosen and enables after clicking a star; AI Picks area is ordered by kickoff (08/07 17:00 → 17:00 → 17:30 → 17:30 → 23:00); tip cards no longer render raw bookmaker screenshots (0 found in cards); red LIVE badge visible on live matches.

critical.issue: Multi-file upload broken. Sending files as 'files' form field (single OR multi) returns 422 'Input should be a valid list' — Pydantic rejects UploadFile where List[UploadFile] is expected. Signature `files: Optional[List[UploadFile]] = File(default=None)` at server.py L685 does not aggregate `files` form entries into a list under current FastAPI/pydantic. Repro: curl -F 'files=@a.png' -F 'files=@b.png' -F 'text=' /api/tips/analyze (or single file under `files`) → 422. Note the `file` (singular) field still works, so users who upload exactly one image via legacy path succeed; users using SubmitTipModal's `files[]` (its <input name='files'> is what the frontend actually sends when publishing multi-image) will hit 422.

integration_issues.issue: Because backend POST /api/tips/analyze rejects the 'files' field, the SubmitTipModal upload-input (which sends multipart 'files') will fail to analyze whenever the user attaches one or more images. Only text-only analyze currently works. This needs backend fix — the frontend UI itself (dropzone, previews, multiple attr, hint 'Up to 4 images') is implemented correctly.

Root cause is the FastAPI/pydantic v2 combo — `Optional[List[UploadFile]] = File(default=None)` does not coerce a single UploadFile into [UploadFile]. Recommended fix: change signature to `files: List[UploadFile] = File(default=[])` (drop Optional, use default_factory list) OR read from Request directly. Confirm with curl -F 'files=@a.png' -F 'files=@b.png' -F 'text=' /api/tips/analyze returns 200.

rca of the issue: POST /api/tips/analyze multi-file bug: FastAPI expresses `files: Optional[List[UploadFile]] = File(default=None)` as a Pydantic model with a Union[List[UploadFile], None] type. Under pydantic v2 (currently pinned) and starlette's multipart parsing, when the client sends one or more form-fields named `files`, FastAPI collects them via python-multipart and hands the raw value (a single UploadFile, or a list) to Pydantic — but only when the field is declared without Optional. With `Optional[...] = File(default=None)`, Pydantic strict-validates the value as a single UploadFile (matching the None branch coercion) and returns list_type validation error whenever any file is actually present. Mitigation: `files: List[UploadFile] = File(default_factory=list)` — verified in FastAPI docs and matches the observed behavior in the 422 payload (`msg: 'Input should be a valid list', input: <single UploadFile>`).
